full_page.content:
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original message on a Christmas card by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
1950, January 10
To My Dear Brother Owen B.J. and to all your dear ones - our dear ones: JOY, PEACE AND GRACE BE YOURS - Better late than never. January 10th 1950. - instead of Dec. 25.
Many thanks for your charitable favor. I succeeded To-day in getting Bernard's certificate off in the mail.
By air this ought to fly over it. Please tell Patrick our dear Brother I am not forgetting his letter - the one I owe for his several weeks back. - just now "snowed under."
Blessed be God in all His designs.
Sincerely your Brother,
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
